1QM 18:2.notes: The phrase 'the sons of Japheth' is supported by repeated evidence. The translation retains the uncertainty in the final 'not' due to the unclear context of the negations.

1QM 18:3.notes: Uncertainty in the reconstruction of 'הית' and its impact on the verb form. The phrase 'יד אל ישראל' is translated conservatively as 'hand to Israel' due to low pattern support for 'hand of a leader'.

1QM 18:4.notes: Uncertain transcription at positions 3, 5, 19. Reconstructed text at positions 1, 17. Phrase evidence suggests 'to all' (positions 8-9) and 'all armies' (positions 16-17), but the latter is less supported. The gloss for 'כִּתִּיִּים' is uncertain.

1QM 18:5.notes: Uncertain elements include the verb 'consecrate/mutilate' (חרם_1), the preposition 'in' (ב##), the verb 'urge' (אוץ), and the plural 'Levites' (לוי[ י ]ם##). Phrase evidence supports 'day (the) that' and 'the priest of the head' but offers weak support for 'he [was] standing'.

1QM 18:6.notes: Uncertain reconstruction in positions 3 and 5. Unclear meaning of 'כיא' in position 23, translated as 'for' based on context.

1QM 18:7.en: You have grown strong with your people to be miraculous. And the covenant you kept for us from then on, and the gates of salvation you opened to us, many times.
1QM 18:7.notes: Uncertain transcription and reconstruction in positions 1, 3, 4, and 19. Position 4 has no recoverable text. The phrase 'many times' is a repeated phrase evidence for positions 19 and 20.

1QM 18:8.en: For the sake of your covenant, and you lifted up our poverty as best in, and you the god of justice made for the sake of your name.
1QM 18:8.notes: The translation reflects visible morphology and high-confidence phrase evidence where available. Uncertainty in reconstruction and glossing is noted for positions 2, 5, 8, 16, and 14. The phrase 'for the sake of your name' follows repeated evidence for positions 15-17. 'As best in' follows evidence for positions 8-9. Other connections are context-free glosses.

1QM 19:2.en: As clouds and as thick clouds, as dew to cover the earth and as rain of showers to give drink to justice and to all her offspring. Arise, vigorous one.
1QM 19:2.notes: The phrase 'it will cover [the] earth' is supported by repeated evidence for positions 8-9. Positions 1 and 18 are reconstructed. Position 8 is uncertain. Position 20 is an unknown punctuation mark and omitted from the translation.

1QM 19:3.en: Take captive the man of weight and plunder the makers of strength. Give your hand on the neck of your enemies and your foot upon high places.
1QM 19:3.notes: The translation follows visible morphology and repeated phrase evidence where available. Uncertainty arises from damaged text and low-confidence constraints. The phrase 'plunder the makers of strength' reflects repeated evidence for positions 6-7 and 8-9. 'Your foot' at position 17 is a reconstruction. 'High places' at position 19 is a plausible restoration but uncertain.

1QM 19:4.notes: Uncertain adversary reading at position 5. Reconstructed text at positions 1 and 18.

1QM 19:5.notes: The transcription contains two uncertain characters and two reconstructions. The phrase 'all the cities of Judah' is supported by repeated phrase evidence.

1QM 19:6.en: Your gates shall always bring the wealth of nations, and their kings shall serve you, and they shall bow down to all your being
1QM 19:6.notes: The phrase 'the wealth of nations' is a high-confidence rendering of positions 6-7. Positions 13-15 are rendered as 'they shall bow down to all' based on repeated phrase evidence, though the support is not dominant. The phrase 'all your being' at positions 15-16 is a tentative rendering with moderate support. The reconstruction of 'Your gates' and 'all' is noted. Uncertainty in the gloss of position 6 is acknowledged.

1QM 19:7.notes: Positions 6-7 translated as a repeated phrase with high support. Positions 9-11 translated as a repeated phrase with moderate support.
